name: markdown-editor
description: MD//WORKS — a browser-native Markdown editor built for real work. Security first, no cloud lock-in, no learning curve. It supports live preview, English spell check (Hunspell), and importing docx file. It feels like a native app and treats AI as a co-writer, not a gimmick.

paragraphs: 100% Local, yet AI-Ready: MD//WORKS is entirely local and cloud-free. Keep your data fully secure on your device, while still leveraging your browser's native AI sidebars for seamless assistance without copy-pasting. Of course, it also offers full support for local LLMs.

Deep Edit Mode - Your editing, remembered: Not just what you wrote, but what you deleted. Batches typing every 5 seconds, tracks large deletions, pastes, replace-all, and formatting with heading context. 500 events max, memory-only, never sent, Base64 omitted. The DEEP badge glows quietly while it listens. You can also leverage AI to analyze your editing process from an objective, third-person perspective (Planned for v1.6.1 or later). For more information about AI integration, see "11. AI-Assisted Writing" in the manual.
Choose a theme based on your working environment: Midnight for focused editing, Paper for reviewing, and Warm for long writing sessions.
features: Bring Word documents directly into your Markdown workflow.
UI: Accessible via File › Import Word.
Imports headings, paragraphs, lists, and simple tables
Converts Word content into editable Markdown
Handles complex tables and shapes as readable placeholders
